title: Isolation, Expansion, and Differentiation of Mesenchymal Stem Cells from the Infrapatellar Fat Pad of the Goat Stifle Joint
protocol: Collect goat femorotibial joint encompassing ~15 cm each of the femoral and tibial regions of the hind limbs.
Place the sample in a sterilized sample collection box and store it at 4 °C for transportation to the laboratory.
Process the samples aseptically in a biosafety cabinet using sterilized surgical tools throughout the procedure.
Rinse the sample thoroughly with autoclaved phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) supplemented with antibiotics (5 µg/mL amphotericin B, 200 U/mL penicillin-streptomycin, and 50 µg/mL ciprofloxacin).
Carefully examine the anatomical regions of the sample.
Remove extra tissues from both long bones to access the joint capsule easily.
Hold the end surface of the femur bone with one hand.
Cut longitudinally towards the joint with sharp scissors.
Remove surrounding muscles and adipose tissue from the bone carefully.
Make an incision at the tibial end of the sample.
Remove muscles and adipose tissue from the tibial bone.
Ensure both long bones are completely exposed and the joint capsule is visible.
Make an incision from either side of the synovium membrane to cut open the articulating joint.
Cut free the patella from the synovium membrane and patellar ligaments using sterilized scissors and forceps.
Keep the separated patella in a Petri dish containing PBS immediately.
Remove the entire fat pad present on the inner surface of the patella.
Collect the removed fat pad in another fresh Petri dish.
Mince the collected fat pad using a scalpel to obtain pieces/segments of approximately 2-3 mm.
Transfer minced tissue using a spatula to a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Wash the tissue with PBS supplemented with antibiotics at room temperature for 15 min in a test tube mixer.
Repeat the washing step 3 times, each for 15 minutes.
Incubate the minced tissue (~5 g) in DMEM low glucose containing 1.5 mg/mL type II collagenase and supplemented with 2% FBS at 37 °C for 12-16 h in a test tube mixer at ~15 RPM.
Aspirate the digested tissue carefully.
Filter the digested tissue through a cell strainer (70 µm) to remove undigested tissue.
Centrifuge the filtrate in a 15 mL centrifuge tube at 150 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and wash the pellet with DMEM low glucose at least twice.
Resuspend the obtained cell pellet in complete DMEM media (DMEM low glucose supplemented with 10% FBS and antibiotics).
Seed the cells on 150 mm Petri dishes.
Culture the cells in expansion media supplemented with 5 ng/mL basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) and 50 µg/mL 2-Phospho-L-ascorbic acid trisodium salt.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator to allow adhesion and proliferation.
Monitor cell attachment and growth on a daily basis.
Change the media every 3 days until cells become confluent.
Add fresh bFGF (5 ng/mL) and 2-Phospho-L-ascorbic acid trisodium salt (50 µg/mL) directly to the Petri dish during each media change.
Remove non-adherent entities during each media change.
Wash cells with PBS if oil droplets are seen after 3 days of incubation, then add fresh media.
Continue washing cells with PBS before each media change until all oil droplets are removed.
Subculture cells when they reach 80%-90% confluence.
Remove expansion media from the Petri dish and wash cells once with PBS.
Add 4 mL of 0.25% trypsin/EDTA to the dish.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 4 min.
Achieve confluency of 80%-90% within 7 days.
Distribute trypsin/EDTA solution uniformly over the Petri dish surface during trypsinization.
Tap the plate gently and observe under a microscope to ensure all cells are detached.
Neutralize the trypsin by adding an equal volume (4 mL) of expansion media.
Collect the dissociated cells using a pipette in a fresh 15 mL polypropylene tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 150 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in the desired volume of expansion media.
Count the cells using the standard cell counting method.
Subculture the cells in 150 mm Petri dishes at a seeding density of 1 x 10^4 cells/cm² for further expansion.
Use confluent monolayers of passage number P2-P5 for all assays.
Cryopreserve excess cells.
Seed cells in expansion media in a 6-well tissue culture plate at a density of 50-100 cells/cm².
Add media to obtain a final volume of 3 mL per well.
Culture the cells for 12 days at 37°C in a 5% CO₂ incubator under standard conditions.
Change the media every 3 days gently.
Rinse colonies once with PBS after 12 days.
Fix the colonies using 20% methanol for 20 min at room temperature.
Stain the colonies with crystal violet dye (0.5% [w/v] in 20% methanol) for 20 min at room temperature.
Count individual colonies using an inverted microscope.
Seed cells at a density of 25 x 10^3 cells/cm^2 in a 24-well tissue culture plate.
Add media to obtain a final volume of 500 μL.
Culture the cells at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator until confluency is reached.
Replace expansion medium with adipogenic differentiation media one day post-confluency, obtaining a final volume of 500 µL.
Prepare adipogenic differentiation media by supplementing expansion media with 25 mM D (+)-glucose, 10 µg/mL insulin, 1 µM dexamethasone, and 100 µM indomethacin.
Consider cells cultured in the expansion medium supplemented with 25 mM D (+) glucose as uninduced controls.
Change media every 3 days for 14 days.
Wash the cells once with PBS at the end of 14 days.
Fix the cells using neutral buffered formalin (NBF; 4 % formaldehyde in PBS) for 15 min at 4 °C.
Following fixation, wash the wells 1x with distilled water.
Incubate the cells with 60% isopropanol for 5 min at RT.
Remove isopropanol from the cells.
Stain lipid droplets by incubating the cells with 500 µL of working Oil Red O dye solution for 5 min at RT.
Wash the wells 1x with distilled water to remove unbound dye.
Image the stained cells using an inverted microscope.
Centrifuge the collected goat blood at 1000 x g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube inside a biosafety cabinet.
Filter the plasma through 0.2 µm filters.
Aliquot and store the filtered plasma at -20 °C.
Maintain the temperature of 2-8 °C while handling the samples.
Culture expanded cells to 80%-90% confluency.
Dissociate the cells using trypsin/EDTA solution.
Pellet down the cells at 150 x g for 5 min in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Resuspend the pellet in goat plasma at a density of 2 x 10^6 cells per 50 µL of plasma solution.
Add a drop of plasma-containing cells (50 µL) onto a sterilized 90 mm Petri dish.
Add calcium chloride at a final concentration of 0.3% (w/v).
Mix well to fabricate cross-linked plasma hydrogel.
Incubate the fabricated hydrogel at 37 °C for 40 min.
Transfer the hydrogels to 24-well tissue culture plates containing chondrogenic media.
Prepare chondrogenic media by supplementing DMEM low glucose with 10 mM HEPES.
Add 1.25 mg/mL bovine serum albumin (BSA) to the media.
Include 1 mM proline and 50 µg/mL 2-Phospho-L-ascorbic acid trisodium salt in the media.
Add 100 nM dexamethasone to the media.
Supplement the media with insulin, transferrin, sodium selenite + linoleic-BSA (ITS+1).
Include antibiotics (2.5 µg/mL amphotericin, 100 U/mL penicillin-streptomycin and 25 µg/mL ciprofloxacin) in the media.
Add 10 ng/mL transforming growth factor-β1 (TGF-β1) to the media.
Culture hydrogels in complete DMEM media without TGF-β1 as uninduced controls.
Change the media every 3 days for 14 days.
Wash the hydrogels with PBS 3 times for 5 min each after 14 days of chondrogenic differentiation.
Fix the samples in NBF for 3 h.
Remove NBF and wash the hydrogels with PBS 3 times for 5 min each.
Incubate the hydrogels in 35% (w/v) sucrose at RT overnight.
Acclimatize the hydrogels in OCT compound for 3 h.
Embed samples in OCT compound using silicone molds under liquid nitrogen.
Cut the samples to a thickness of 10-12 μm on gelatin-coated glass slides using a cryotome.
Store the sections at -20°C for future use.
Stain the sections with Alcian Blue and Safranin-O dye.
Dissolve 1 g of Alcian Blue dye in 100 mL of 0.1 N HCl and mix thoroughly overnight.
Store the Alcian Blue solution at room temperature for 1 month in the dark.
Wash hydrogel sections once with distilled water for 5 min.
Add 4% neutral buffered formalin (NBF) to slides and incubate for 30 min.
Wash the sections once with distilled water for 5 min, then twice with 0.1 N HCl for 30 s each.
Remove the HCl and gently dry the slides with tissue paper.
Add prepared Alcian Blue stain to the sections and incubate at 37°C in a humidified chamber for 30 min.
Wash unbound dye with 0.1 N HCl, then distilled water for 3 min.
Dehydrate the sections in absolute ethanol.
Clear the sections in xylene.
Mount the stained sections in resinous medium for imaging.
Wash hydrogel sections with distilled water for 5 min.
Add 4% neutral buffered formalin (NBF) to the slides and incubate for 30 min.
Wash the sections with distilled water for 5 min.
Dip the slides in 1% acetic acid for 10-15 s.
Dry the slides gently with tissue paper.
Add prepared Safranin-O dye to the sections and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash unbound dye with 100% ethanol.
Dip the slides in 100% ethanol for 5 min.
Air-dry the slides.
Clear the slides in xylene.
Mount the stained sections in a resinous medium for imaging.
Trypsinize cells as stated before (Step 2.2).
Seed cells at a density of 3 x 10^3 cells/cm^2 in a 24-well tissue culture plate.
Add media to obtain a final volume of 500 μL.
Culture the cells at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Replace expansion media with osteogenic differentiation media one day post-seeding.

Prepare osteogenic media by supplementing expansion media (DMEM + 10% FBS +2.5 µg/mL amphotericin, 100 U/mL penicillin-streptomycin, and 25 µg/mL ciprofloxacin) with 25 mM D (+)-glucose, 10 nM dexamethasone, 10 mM β-glycerophosphate, 50 µg/mL L-ascorbic acid 2-phosphate, and 10 nM vitamin D3.
Change the osteogenic media every 3 days for 14 days or 28 days.
Dissolve one BCIP/NBT tablet in 10 mL of distilled water to prepare the substrate solution.
Break the tablet in half and dissolve it in 5 mL of distilled water if needed.
Add Tris buffer (100 mM) and magnesium chloride (5 mM) to distilled water for permeabilization buffer preparation.
Add Triton X100 (0.1%) to the permeabilization buffer solution.
Adjust the pH of the permeabilization buffer to 9.25-9.75.
Remove the media after 14 days and wash cells with PBS.
Fix cells using NBF (4%) for 1 min.
Wash fixed cells with PBS.
Permeate cells using prepared lysis buffer for 2-3 min.
Add 500 µL of substrate solution to the cells.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min to 1 h, depending on expression level.
Check development of purple/blue color periodically during incubation.
Remove the substrate solution and wash with distilled water.
Image stained cells using an inverted microscope.
Measure extent of calcification after osteogenic induction by Alizarin Red-S staining at the end of 28 days.
Dissolve 2 g of Alizarin Red-S in 100 mL of distilled water to prepare the staining solution.
Adjust the pH of the Alizarin Red-S solution to 4.1-4.3 with HCl or NH4OH.
Filter the prepared solution through a 0.22 µm membrane and store at 4 °C in the dark.
After 28 days of induction, remove media from cells.
Wash cells once with cold PBS.
Fix cells using 70% ethanol for 1 h at 4 °C.
Remove fixative and wash cells twice with distilled water.
Add 1 mL of Alizarin Red-S solution to each well after removing the distilled water completely.
Incubate cells with Alizarin Red-S solution for 1 h at room temperature.
Image cells using an inverted microscope.
